description: This Java class defines an immutable command object for creating or updating client notes within the Fineract project. It encapsulates a single 'note' field and provides validation logic to ensure the note is not blank and does not exceed a length of 1000 characters, throwing a validation exception if constraints are violated.

classes.name: ClientNoteCommand
classes.description: An immutable class representing a command for creating or updating client notes, including validation logic for the 'note' field.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the 'note' field with the provided string.

methods.description: Validates the 'note' field to ensure it is not blank and does not exceed 1000 characters; throws a validation exception if validations fail.
